questions.stemEn: An infant has cleft palate, clenched fists, rocker-bottom feet, PDA and VSD. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: Clenched fists مع overlapping fingers وrocker-bottom feet هي clues قوية لـTrisomy 18، مع شيوع congenital heart disease. لذلك المصدر يختار Edwards syndrome.
questions.reasoningEn: The phenotype described is characteristic of trisomy 18, particularly clenched fists and rocker-bottom feet.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Trisomy 13 يرتبط أكثر بـmidline defects، holoprosencephaly وpolydactyly. VACTERL لا يفسر هذا النمط الكروموسومي المميز.
questions.clinicalPearl: Trisomy 18: growth restriction, prominent occiput, micrognathia, clenched hands with overlapping fingers and rocker-bottom feet.

image.sourceRef: Infant dysmorphology image in Genetics Q11
image.captionAr: الصورة الأصلية جزء أساسي من التعرف على Trisomy 18.
image.captionEn: Original source image shows dysmorphic features of trisomy 18.

tts.text: An infant has cleft palate, clenched fists, rocker-bottom feet, PDA and VSD. What is the most likely diagnosis? A. Trisomy 13, Patau syndrome. B. Trisomy 18, Edwards syndrome. C. VACTERL association.

questions.stemEn: A neonate has epicanthal folds and excessive skin at the nape of the neck, consistent with trisomy 21. What is the most likely genetic basis?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يذكر أن أغلب free trisomy 21 تنتج عن maternal meiotic error، ولذلك الإجابة B.
questions.reasoningEn: Most free trisomy 21 cases result from maternal meiotic nondisjunction in the source explanation.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Translocation وmosaicism أسباب أقل شيوعًا، وpaternal errors تمثل نسبة صغيرة.
questions.clinicalPearl: Down syndrome can result from free trisomy 21, Robertsonian translocation or mosaicism; cytogenetic type matters for recurrence counseling.

tts.text: A neonate has epicanthal folds and excessive skin at the nape of the neck, consistent with trisomy 21. What is the most likely genetic basis? A. Paternal non-meiotic error. B. Maternal meiotic error. C. Translocation. D. Mosaicism.

questions.stemEn: An 18-year-old mother delivers a baby with Down syndrome. Karyotype shows a translocation between chromosomes 14 and 21. What should be done next?

options.text: Because the mother is 18, recurrence risk is low
Recurrence risk is the same as the general population

questions.explanationAr: وجود Robertsonian translocation 14;21 يستدعي chromosome analysis للوالدين لتحديد هل translocation de novo أم familial؛ المصدر يختار paternal chromosome study ضمن الخيارات، مع أن التقييم المثالي يشمل كلا الوالدين.
questions.reasoningEn: Parental chromosome analysis is required after translocation Down syndrome to identify a balanced carrier and estimate recurrence risk.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: صغر عمر الأم لا يلغي recurrence risk الناتج عن balanced translocation. والخطر ليس بالضرورة مثل general population.
questions.clinicalPearl: Translocation Down syndrome changes recurrence counseling; karyotype both parents when possible.

image.captionEn: Original source karyotype shows a 14;21 translocation.

questions.stemEn: A newborn has Down syndrome with a 14;21 translocation. The father has a normal chromosome study and the mother carries a 14;21 translocation. What is the recurrence risk?
questions.explanationAr: حسب المصدر، إذا كانت الأم carrier لـRobertsonian translocation involving 14;21 فالـrecurrence risk حوالي 10–15%، بينما يكون أقل إذا كان الأب هو carrier.
questions.reasoningEn: The source gives a 10–15% recurrence risk when the mother carries a 14;21 Robertsonian translocation.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: الخيارات الأعلى لا تطابق 14;21 maternal carrier في المصدر. 100% يرتبط بtranslocation بين chromosome 21 و21.
questions.clinicalPearl: Recurrence risk in Robertsonian translocations depends on the chromosomes involved and which parent is the carrier.

questions.stemEn: Turner syndrome most commonly occurs due to which of the following?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار paternal meiotic nondisjunction ويذكر أن فقدان الـpaternal sex chromosome يمثل أغلبية كبيرة من liveborn 45,X cases في المراجع التي استند إليها.
questions.reasoningEn: The source attributes most liveborn 45,X cases to loss/non-disjunction of the paternal sex chromosome.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Maternal nondisjunction أقل شيوعًا في شرح المصدر، وtranslocation ليست الآلية المعتادة لـ45,X.
questions.clinicalPearl: Turner syndrome is usually sporadic; parental age is not used like maternal-age risk for trisomy 21.

tts.text: Turner syndrome most commonly occurs due to which of the following? A. Maternal meiotic nondisjunction. B. Paternal meiotic nondisjunction. C. Translocation.

questions.stemEn: A 14-year-old girl has primary amenorrhea, short stature, normal mentality and a webbed neck. What cardiac finding is most likely?

options.text: Systolic ejection murmur best heard under the left scapula

questions.explanationAr: الـphenotype يشير إلى Turner syndrome، التي ترتبط بـcoarctation of the aorta وbicuspid aortic valve. المصدر يربط left infrascapular systolic murmur بـcoarctation.
questions.reasoningEn: Turner syndrome is associated with coarctation; a murmur can be heard over the left infrascapular region.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Fixed split S2 يوحي أكثر بـASD، loud single S2 لا يطابق هذا clue، وdextrocardia ليست association المعتادة.
questions.clinicalPearl: Turner syndrome warrants cardiovascular assessment for coarctation, bicuspid aortic valve and aortic disease.

questions.stemEn: A karyotype consistent with Turner syndrome is provided. What is the most common associated renal anomaly?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار horseshoe kidney كأشهر renal anomaly مرتبطة بـTurner syndrome.
questions.reasoningEn: Horseshoe kidney is the renal anomaly identified by the source for Turner syndrome.
questions.clinicalPearl: Turner syndrome evaluation includes renal imaging because congenital renal anomalies are common.

questions.stemEn: A 6-year-old girl has short stature and a history of aortic coarctation repair at age 3 years. Which syndrome is most likely?
questions.explanationAr: Short stature + repaired coarctation are classic clues يمكن أن تدفع نحو Turner syndrome في فتاة، ولذلك المصدر يختار A. لكن Noonan syndrome أيضًا قد يرتبط short stature وcardiac disease، لذا يظل التحقق من كامل phenotype مهمًا.
questions.reasoningEn: The source prioritizes Turner syndrome based on female sex, short stature and coarctation of the aorta.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Noonan syndrome يبقى differential ممكنًا إذا وُجدت ملامح أخرى مثل pulmonary stenosis أوtypical facies؛ stem لا يذكرها.
questions.clinicalPearl: Consider Turner syndrome in any girl with unexplained short stature, especially with left-sided cardiac defects.
